name: Da Lat strawberries
summary: The fresh berry from the Da Lat farms, separate from the condensed-milk cup.
origin: A March 2025 Lam Dong science bulletin names dâu tây Đà Lạt among the province’s OCOP strengths. Vietnam Tourism names strawberries among the crops the farms are known for.
howToEat: Buy the fruit at the market in the daytime. The cup with condensed milk is dâu sữa, a different order. Wash the fruit if you are cautious.
where: Da Lat Market, on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake. The rural desk also names strawberries at seasonal fairs, including one in Cam Ly. A kilogram price is Check on arrival. Market hours are Check on arrival.
seoDescription: The fresh berry from the Da Lat farms, separate from the condensed-milk cup.
